caption: A close-up shot features the face of a tabby cat with brown and black striped fur and a pink nose. The cat's large green eyes are focused slightly to the right of the camera lens. Long white whiskers extend from the muzzle, contrasting with the blurred, light-colored background. The image has a shallow depth of field that keeps the cat's face sharp while softening the surroundings.

A small, reddish-brown ceramic cup filled with light brown coffee sits centrally on a matching saucer. A silver metal spoon rests on the right side of the saucer, its handle extending slightly off the edge. The cup features a white interior rim that contrasts with the darker exterior glaze. The entire arrangement is placed on a textured wooden table surface with visible grain and scratches. The lighting casts soft shadows to the left, highlighting the glossy finish of the ceramic and the reflective surface of the spoon.

The image displays a minimalist composition of five geometric shapes arranged in two rows against a plain white background. The top row features three identical red circles spaced evenly apart horizontally. Below them, the second row consists of two blue squares positioned in the spaces between the circles. The visual style is flat and graphic, utilizing solid primary colors without gradients or shadows.

A minimalist illustration features a beige house with a red triangular roof situated on a green lawn. The house has a brown door and two square blue windows with white frames. To the right of the house stands a tree with a brown trunk and a large, circular green canopy. The background consists of a light blue sky containing two white, fluffy clouds. The visual style is flat and geometric, utilizing solid blocks of color without gradients or shading.

A white rocket stands vertically on a launchpad, centered in the frame against a deep blue twilight sky. Tall metal lattice towers flank the rocket on both sides, with two larger structures in the foreground and two smaller ones closer to the launch vehicle. Bright artificial lights at the base of the structure create starburst flares, illuminating the lower portion of the rocket and the surrounding infrastructure. The rocket features a pointed nose cone and visible markings near the top, while the background sky transitions from a darker blue at the top to a lighter hue near the horizon.
